questionEn: Which of the following corresponds to the material in the paragraph “Molecule. Relative molecular weight"?
questionUz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri "Molekula. Nisbiy molekulyar og'irlik" bandidagi materialga mos keladi?
choicesEn: this is a value indicating how many times the mass of a molecule of a substance is greater than 1/12 the mass of a carbon-12 atom
particle consisting of a group of interconnected atoms
this is a value showing how many times the mass of a molecule of a substance is greater than 1/12 of the mass of an atom.
this is a special type of atomic movement
choicesUz: bu moddaning molekulasining massasi uglerod-12 atomining massasining 1/12 qismidan necha marta katta ekanligini ko'rsatadigan qiymat
o'zaro bog'langan atomlar guruhidan tashkil topgan zarracha

explanationEn: The relative molecular mass of a substance is a value that shows how many times the mass of a molecule of a substance is greater than 1/12 the mass of a carbon-12 atom.
explanationUz: Moddaning nisbiy molekulyar massasi - bu modda molekulasining massasi uglerod-12 atomining massasining 1/12 qismidan necha marta katta ekanligini ko'rsatadigan qiymat.
